body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.9.0: Now, the rite for the cattle pen (<s>goṣṭhakarma</s>). 3.9.1: 'May the resounding [cows] keep you from slaughter by the army; may the cows of that same cattle-lord be [his] share; may no harm befall you'—[reciting] '<s>Pūṣā</s>, may he follow our cows (<s>pūṣā gā anv etu naḥ</s>),' he recites the blessing as the cows go forth [to pasture]. 3.9.2: [Reciting] 'Around, O <s>Pūṣan</s> (<s>pari pūṣā</s>)' when they have gone around. 3.9.3: 'Those whose four-holed udders are full of honey and ghee—may they be our many milk-yielding [cows] in the cattle pen, dripping with ghee'—and [reciting] 'The cows have come (<s>ā gāvo agmann</s>)' when they have returned. 3.9.4: [He brings] the best one home. 3.9.5: [Reciting] the hymn 'May the wind be refreshing to us (<s>mayobhūr vāta</s>)' [when they have] entered the cattle pen.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.10.0: Now, the rite of branding cattle (<s>gavām aṅkanakarma</s>). 3.10.1: On the new-moon day that falls on the later <s>Phālgunī</s> [asterism], which coincides with <s>Revatī</s>, one should have the brand-marks made. 3.10.2: 'You are the world, thousand-nourishing. For <s>Indra</s>, the weary one gives you. You are uninjured, unharmed. <s>Ilā</s>, food, protector of cows—for as many as I shall do this, and for yet more, may I be performing [this rite] in the best year'—[thus he recites]. 3.10.3: The <s>pīyūṣa</s> (colostrum) of the [cow] that gives birth first should be offered, [reciting] the two verses 'The yearly milk of the she-cow (<s>saṃvatsarīṇam paya usriyāyāḥ</s>).' 3.10.4: If twins are born, having offered with the <s>mahāvyāhṛtis</s>, he should give the twin-bearing cow [as a gift].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.11.0: Now, the rite of releasing the bull (<s>vṛṣotsarga</s>). 3.11.1: Now, the releasing of the bull. 3.11.2: On the full-moon day of <s>Kārttikī</s>, or on the <s>Revatī</s> [asterism] of <s>Āśvayuja</s>. 3.11.3: Having kindled a fire well in the midst of the cows, he offers ghee oblations. 3.11.4: 'Here is delight, here rejoice. <s>Svāhā</s>. Here is steadfastness, here is self-support. <s>Svāhā</s>. Release the young one, a support to its mother; the support [calf] suckling the mother—may it bestow increase of wealth upon us. <s>Svāhā</s>.' 3.11.5: He offers to <s>Pūṣan</s>, [reciting] '<s>Pūṣā</s>, may he follow our cows (<s>pūṣā gā anv etu naḥ</s>).' 3.11.6: Having recited [the hymns] to the <s>Rudras</s>. 3.11.7: [The bull may be] of one color, two colors, or three colors.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.12.0: Now, the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> festivals. 3.12.1: After the full-moon of <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s> (Mārgaśīrṣa), three <s>Aṣṭakās</s> [are observed] in the dark fortnights. 3.12.2: At the first of these, one offers vegetables (<s>śāka</s>). 3.12.3: [Reciting:] "She indeed is the first who has dawned; within her she moves, having entered. The bride has given birth, the newly-creating mother—may three powers (<s>mahimāna</s>) accompany her. <s>Svāhā</s>." 3.12.4: Then [the oblation] to <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s>. 3.12.5: [Reciting:] "In whom <s>Yama</s>, son of <s>Vivasvat</s>, and all the gods are established—the <s>Aṣṭakā</s>, facing all directions, may she satisfy my desires. They call your teeth pressing-stones, your udder the purifier. The months and half-months—homage to you, O gracious-faced one. <s>Svāhā</s>."

body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.13.1: At the middle [<s>Aṣṭakā</s>], and during the middle rainfall [season]. 3.13.2: [With] the four great <s>vyāhṛtis</s> and the four [verses beginning] "Those who have crossed over (<s>ye tātṛṣuḥ</s>)," having pursued [the animal], one should offer the omentum (<s>vapā</s>). 3.13.3: Or [reciting:] "Carry the omentum, O <s>Jātavedas</s> (fire), to the ancestors, where you know them in the world of the well-doers. May streams of fat flow to them; may the wishes of the sacrificer be true. <s>Svāhā</s>." 3.13.4: The four great <s>vyāhṛtis</s> and the four [verses beginning] "Those who have crossed over"—an eight-oblation <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering) mixed with cut portions. 3.13.5: Or [reciting:] "The mountains are hidden, the great earth is hidden from me, with heaven and all the directions. I place another within, from the father, for such-and-such. <s>Svāhā</s>. The seasons are hidden from me, and the days-and-nights born at the junctions, the months and half-months. I place another within, from the father, for such-and-such. <s>Svāhā</s>. Those [waters] that stand still, those that flow, those that are small and overflowing—with the waters that sustain all, I place another within, from the father, for such-and-such. <s>Svāhā</s>. What my mother transgressed, wandering without a husband's vow—may my father claim that seed; another has fallen from the mother, for such-and-such. <s>Svāhā</s>."—these four [verses are used] in place of the great <s>vyāhṛtis</s>, as alternatives to [the regular] procedure. 3.13.6: Or a milk-porridge (<s>pāyasa</s>) offering (<s>caru</s>). 3.13.7: On the following day is the <s>anvaṣṭakya</s> (day after the <s>Aṣṭakā</s>), following the procedure of the <s>piṇḍapitṛyajña</s> (offering of rice-balls to the ancestors).

body.translated_text: ŚGS 3.14.1: At the last [<s>Aṣṭakā</s>], one offers cakes (<s>apūpa</s>). 3.14.2: [Reciting:] "The <s>Ukthya</s> and the <s>Atirātra</s>, and the <s>Sadyaḥkrī</s> together with the meters (<s>chandas</s>)—O <s>Aṣṭakā</s>, maker of cakes, homage to you, O gracious-faced one. <s>Svāhā</s>." 3.14.3: [The offering consists of] a cow, a goat, or a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering). 3.14.4: Or one may bring a mouthful [of fodder] for a cow. 3.14.5: Or one may burn dry grass in the forest, [saying] "This is my <s>Aṣṭakā</s>." 3.14.6: But one should by no means neglect [the observance]; one should by no means neglect it.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.1.0: Now, the <s>śrāddha</s> rite (ancestral offering). 4.1.1: Month by month, one should give [offerings] to the ancestors (<s>pitṛ</s>). 4.1.2: Having seated an odd number of <s>brāhmaṇas</s> who know the <s>Vedas</s>, at least three, [treating them] as [representing] the ancestors. 4.1.3: Having sprinkled sesame seeds into an odd number of water vessels. 4.1.4: Having designated [each offering] "So-and-so, this is for you," he should pour [the offering] into the hands of the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>. 4.1.5: While they eat, he should mutter the great <s>vyāhṛtis</s>, the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the <s>Madhuvatīya</s> [verses], the ancestor-deity [verses], and the <s>Pāvamānī</s> [hymns]. 4.1.6: When they have eaten, he should give the rice-balls (<s>piṇḍa</s>). 4.1.10: Some [place them] in front. 4.1.11: Having placed the rice-balls behind, [he places something] between for the wives [of the ancestors], concealing it somewhat. 4.1.12: He should report the remainder to the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>. 4.1.13: The procedure, beginning with the offering into the fire and through the <s>piṇḍapitṛyajña</s>, has been explained.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.2.0: Now, the <s>ekodiṣṭa śrāddha</s> rite (offering dedicated to a single [recently deceased] person). 4.2.1: Now, the <s>ekodiṣṭa</s> [offering]. 4.2.2: One purificatory [<s>kuśa</s> blade]. 4.2.3: One <s>arghya</s> (water of respect). 4.2.4: One rice-ball (<s>piṇḍa</s>). 4.2.5: There is no invocation (<s>āvāhana</s>), no offering into the fire, no [invocation of] the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> (All-gods); [instead of] "Is it pleasing (<s>svaditam</s>)?" [one asks] the question of satisfaction (<s>tṛptapraśna</s>); [instead of] "May it endure (<s>akṣayya</s>)" [one says] "May [the merit] stand." 4.2.6: "May there be delight (<s>abhiramyatām</s>)"—this is the dismissal. 4.2.7: Thus for one year after the death. 4.2.8: And the dismissal [verse includes] the fourth [<s>vyāhṛti</s>].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.3.0: Now, the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s> (incorporation into the ancestral group). 4.3.1: Now, the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s>. 4.3.2: When a full year [has passed], or three fortnights. 4.3.3: Or on whatever day prosperity is attained. 4.3.4: Having prepared four water vessels containing sesame, fragrance, and water. 4.3.5: Three for the ancestors (<s>pitṛs</s>), one for the deceased (<s>preta</s>). 4.3.6: He pours the vessel of the deceased into the vessels of the ancestors [reciting] the two [verses beginning] '<s>ye samānāḥ</s>' ('those who are the same'). 4.3.7: Likewise with the <s>piṇḍa</s> (rice-ball offering) also. 4.3.8: This is the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s>.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.4.0: Now, the <s>ābhyudayika śrāddha</s> rite (auspicious ancestor rite). 4.4.1: Now, the <s>ābhyudayika</s> [rite]. 4.4.2: During the waxing fortnight, on an auspicious day. 4.4.3: Having performed the <s>mātṛ-yāga</s> (offering to the mothers). 4.4.4: Seating an even number of <s>Veda</s>-knowers. 4.4.5: In the forenoon. 4.4.6: The ritual service proceeds clockwise (<s>pradakṣiṇa</s>). 4.4.7: The recitation excludes ancestral <s>mantras</s>. 4.4.8: The <s>darbha</s> grasses are straight. 4.4.9: Barley serves in place of sesame. 4.4.10: The <s>piṇḍas</s> (rice-ball offerings) are mixed with yogurt, jujube berries, and unbroken rice (<s>akṣata</s>). 4.4.11: At the invocation [one says]: 'I shall invoke the <s>nāndīmukha</s> ancestors.' 4.4.12: In the place of the imperishable offering [one says]: 'May the <s>nāndīmukha</s> ancestors be pleased.' 4.4.13: At the formal address [one says]: 'I shall address the <s>nāndīmukha</s> ancestors.' 4.4.14: The inquiry about satisfaction [is]: 'Is it complete (<s>sampanna</s>)?' 4.4.15: The remainder [of the rite is] the same [as the regular <s>śrāddha</s>], except what is contradictory.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.5.0: Now, the <s>upākaraṇa</s> (commencement of Vedic study). 4.5.1: Now, the <s>upākaraṇa</s>. 4.5.2: At the appearance of the herbs, [in the month] with <s>Hasta</s> or <s>Śravaṇa</s> [<s>nakṣatra</s>]. 4.5.3: Some say one should offer with each verse of the <s>Veda</s>, [portions of] unbroken rice (<s>akṣata</s>), flour (<s>saktu</s>), and parched grains (<s>dhānā</s>) mixed with yogurt and ghee. 4.5.4: Or with [the verses] beginning the hymn (<s>sūkta</s>) and section (<s>anuvāka</s>). 4.5.5: <s>Māṇḍūkeya</s> [says]: with [the verses] beginning the chapter (<s>adhyāya</s>) and the <s>ārṣeya</s> (seer-grouping). 4.5.6: Now <s>Kauṣītaki</s> has thus stated: 4.5.7: '<s>agnim īḍe purohitam</s>' — this is one [verse]. 4.5.8: [Then the verses:] '<s>Kuṣumbhaka</s> said that'; '<s>āvadaṃs tvam śakune bhadram ā vada</s>'; '<s>gṛṇānā jamadagninā</s>'; '<s>dhāman te viśvam bhuvanam adhiśritam</s>'; '<s>gantā no yajñam yajñiyāḥ</s>'; '<s>suśami yo naḥ svo araṇaḥ prati cakṣva</s>'; '<s>vi cakṣva</s>'; '<s>ā agne yāhi marutsakhā</s>'; '<s>yat te rājan śṛtam haviḥ</s>' — these are pairs of verses (<s>dvṛcā</s>). 4.5.9: '<s>tat śamyor ā vṛṇīmahe</s>' — this is one [verse]. 4.5.10: From the remainder of the oblation, they eat the offering with [the verse] '<s>dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam</s>.' 4.5.11: Having sipped water (<s>ācamya</s>), [they] sit down. 4.5.12: Having recited the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s> (great utterances), the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the [verses] beginning with the <s>Veda</s>-opening, and the <s>svastyayana</s> (benedictory formulas). 4.5.13: One should bid farewell (<s>svasti</s>) to the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher). 4.5.14: On this, there is also [a verse]: 4.5.15: 'Desiring the unwearied worship, the essence of the Vedic meters — the <s>ṛṣis</s> (seers) beheld the <s>upākarma</s> (commencement) through the power of their austerity.' 4.5.16: 'Therefore, one engaged in the six-fold rites, for the accomplishment of one's <s>mantras</s>, should perform the <s>upākarma</s> — so say those who desire the success of their rites.' 4.5.17: 'At the <s>upākaraṇa</s> and <s>utsarga</s>, there should be a three-night fast; at the <s>aṣṭakā</s> rites, [a fast of] one day and night; and at the seasonal-end nights.'

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.6.0: Now, the <s>utsarga</s> rite (conclusion/suspension of Vedic study). 4.6.1: On the first day of the bright half of <s>Māgha</s>. 4.6.2: In the unconquered direction (i.e., the northeast). 4.6.3: In a place rich with herbs. 4.6.4: Having recited the solar [verses]: '<s>ud u tyam jātavedasam</s>,' '<s>citram devānām</s>,' '<s>namo mitrasya</s>,' '<s>sūryo no divas pātu</s>.' 4.6.5: With [the verse] '<s>śāsa itthā mahān asi</s>,' [he] casts clods of earth in each direction, circumambulating, [reciting] each verse in each direction. 4.6.6: Having satiated the <s>ṛṣis</s>, meters (<s>chandas</s>), deities, <s>śraddhā</s> (faith) and <s>medhā</s> (intellect), and the ancestors (<s>pitṛs</s>) for each generation. 4.6.7: They give rest to the Vedic meters for six and a half months. 4.6.8: Or for five and a half. 4.6.9: If they wish to study, after pausing for a day and night, they begin the study.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.7.0: Now, the rules for cessation [of study] (<s>uparama-karma</s>). ŚGS 4.7.1: Now, cessation. ŚGS 4.7.2: During portents (<s>utpāta</s>), [cessation is] at any time. ŚGS 4.7.3: And during other extraordinary occurrences. ŚGS 4.7.4: During lightning, thunder, and rain, [cessation lasts] through three <s>sandhyā</s> (junction) periods. ŚGS 4.7.5: For one day, when eating at a <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral offering). ŚGS 4.7.6: For ten days, during impurity from death (<s>agha</s>) and birth (<s>sūtaka</s>). ŚGS 4.7.7: On the fourteenth [<s>tithi</s>], on new-moon days (<s>amāvāsyā</s>), and during the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> rites. ŚGS 4.7.8: On [certain] days and during cloudy [periods]. ŚGS 4.7.9: And when the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) has died, for ten days. ŚGS 4.7.10: Having heard [of the death later], for three nights. ŚGS 4.7.11: And for those senior to him [likewise]. ŚGS 4.7.12: Upon receiving a gift (<s>pratigraha</s>), as for a <s>śrāddha</s>. ŚGS 4.7.13: [When a death occurs among] a fellow-student (<s>sabrahmacārin</s>). ŚGS 4.7.14: Having followed a funeral procession. ŚGS 4.7.15: And having placed <s>piṇḍas</s> (rice-balls) for the ancestors. ŚGS 4.7.16: At night. ŚGS 4.7.17: At twilight (<s>sandhyā</s>). ŚGS 4.7.18: On <s>parvan</s> days (sacred junctions). ŚGS 4.7.19: When [the sun has] set. ŚGS 4.7.20: In the proximity of a <s>Śūdra</s>. ŚGS 4.7.21: When the sound of <s>Sāman</s> [chanting] is heard. ŚGS 4.7.22: In a cremation ground (<s>śmaśāna</s>). ŚGS 4.7.23: In the wilderness between villages. ŚGS 4.7.24: In a village where a corpse is [present]. ŚGS 4.7.25: [On seeing] something that should not be seen. ŚGS 4.7.26: [On hearing] something that should not be heard. ŚGS 4.7.27: When there is an unpleasant smell. ŚGS 4.7.28: During a strong wind. ŚGS 4.7.29: When rain-clouds [gather]. ŚGS 4.7.30: On a highway. ŚGS 4.7.31: And when the sound of a <s>vīṇā</s> (lute) [is heard]. ŚGS 4.7.32: While on a chariot. ŚGS 4.7.33: As for a <s>Śūdra</s>, [so also] in [the presence of] a dog. ŚGS 4.7.34: When climbing a tree. ŚGS 4.7.35: When descending into a pit. ŚGS 4.7.36: In water. ŚGS 4.7.37: When weeping. ŚGS 4.7.38: In distress. ŚGS 4.7.39: When naked. ŚGS 4.7.40: When impure (with remnants of food in the mouth). ŚGS 4.7.41: At a crossing. ŚGS 4.7.42: [Cessation lasts from] the shaving of hair and beard until the [subsequent] bath. ŚGS 4.7.43: During a massage. ŚGS 4.7.44: During bathing. ŚGS 4.7.45: While lying down. ŚGS 4.7.46: During anointing. ŚGS 4.7.47: In [the presence of] one who has touched a corpse, a woman in confinement (<s>sūtikā</s>), or a menstruating woman (<s>udakyā</s>), as [in the case of] a <s>Śūdra</s>. ŚGS 4.7.48: With hands covered. ŚGS 4.7.49: In an army [camp]. ŚGS 4.7.50: When a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> is not eating, and among cows. ŚGS 4.7.51: When [these occasions] have passed, they should [resume] study. ŚGS 4.7.52: If among these some portent should arise involuntarily, having controlled the breath (<s>prāṇāyāma</s>) and having gazed at the sun, one should [resume] study. ŚGS 4.7.53: Except for lightning, thunder, and rain; in the <s>Kalpa</s> [supplements], [the cessation is] as for rain, in the half-months and at the sixths [of the year]. ŚGS 4.7.54: On this, there is also this [verse]: ŚGS 4.7.55: 'Food, water, roots, fruits, and whatever else is offered at a <s>śrāddha</s>—even after receiving [these], a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> is considered to be in a state of non-study (<s>anadhyāya</s>), with [food] in hand and mouth.'

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.8.1: And he should conduct [study] with those who approach properly (<s>nyāyopeta</s>). ŚGS 4.8.2: The <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) sits facing east or north; the other [student sits] to the south, facing north. ŚGS 4.8.3: Or two [students]. ŚGS 4.8.4: But if more, as space permits. ŚGS 4.8.5: One should not sit on a raised seat near the <s>guru</s> (teacher). ŚGS 4.8.6: Nor on the same seat [as the teacher]. ŚGS 4.8.7: Nor with legs stretched out. ŚGS 4.8.8: Nor with arms clasping the knees. ŚGS 4.8.9: Nor with the body leaning [against something]. ŚGS 4.8.10: Nor with feet placed in the lap. ŚGS 4.8.11: Nor sitting in the 'foot-axe' posture (<s>pāda-kuṭhārikā</s>). ŚGS 4.8.12: Having said '<s>adhīhi bho</s>' ('Recite, sir'), the teacher should prompt [with] the syllable '<s>Om</s>.' ŚGS 4.8.13: '<s>Om</s>' — thus the other (student) responds. ŚGS 4.8.14: Continuously thereafter, he should study. ŚGS 4.8.15: Having studied, having clasped [the teacher's feet]. ŚGS 4.8.16: Having said '<s>viratāḥ sma bho</s>' ('We have ceased, sir'), [he proceeds] as appropriate. ŚGS 4.8.17: Some [say] 'Dismissed; cessation [of study lasts] that long.' ŚGS 4.8.18: One should not pass between those who are studying. ŚGS 4.8.19: One should not move about [carelessly] while studying. ŚGS 4.8.20: If there should be a fault, having fasted for three nights or for a day and a night, he should repeat the <s>Sāvitrī</s> as much as he is able, should give something to <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, and having ceased [study] for a day and a night, [he should resume] the study.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.9.0: Now, the <s>tarpaṇa</s> (water libation). 4.9.1: Having bathed, 4.9.2: at the time of <s>upasparśana</s> (ritual touching of water), having immersed himself, he satisfies the deities. 4.9.3: [He recites:] "May <s>Agni</s> be satisfied, may <s>Vāyu</s> be satisfied, may <s>Sūrya</s> be satisfied, may <s>Viṣṇu</s> be satisfied, may <s>Prajāpati</s> be satisfied, may <s>Virūpākṣa</s> be satisfied, may <s>Sahasrākṣa</s> (the thousand-eyed one) be satisfied. May <s>Soma</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, the <s>Vedas</s>, the gods, the <s>ṛṣis</s> (seers), and all the metres, the <s>Oṃkāra</s>, the <s>Vaṣaṭkāra</s>, the great <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances), the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the sacrifices, heaven and earth, the constellations, the atmosphere, days and nights, the numbers, the twilights, the oceans, the rivers, the mountains, the fields, herbs, trees, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Apsarases</s>, <s>Nāgas</s> — may all beings ending with these be satisfied. I satisfy <s>Śruti</s> (revelation), I satisfy <s>Smṛti</s> (tradition), I satisfy <s>Dhṛti</s> (steadfastness), I satisfy <s>Rati</s> (delight), I satisfy <s>Gati</s> (progress), I satisfy <s>Mati</s> (intellect), and <s>Śraddhā</s> (faith), <s>Medhā</s> (wisdom), and <s>Dhāraṇā</s> (retention). May cows, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, stationary and moving beings, all creatures be satisfied" — [this he recites] wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder (<s>yajñopavītī</s>).

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.10.1: Now, [wearing the sacred thread] over the right shoulder (<s>prācīnavītī</s>), 4.10.2: looking toward the direction of the ancestors (south), 4.10.3: [he recites:] "The [seers] of the <s>Śatarcin</s> (Ṛgveda, first maṇḍala), the <s>Mādhyamas</s>, <s>Gṛtsamada</s>, <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, <s>Jamadagni</s>, <s>Vāmadeva</s>, <s>Atri</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, the <s>Pragāthas</s>, the <s>Pavamānas</s>, the <s>Kṣudrasūktas</s> and <s>Mahāsūktas</s>; <s>Sumantu</s>, <s>Jaimini</s>, <s>Vaiśampāyana</s>, <s>Paila</s>; [the teachers of] the <s>Sūtras</s> and <s>Bhāṣyas</s>; <s>Gārgya</s>, <s>Babhru</s>, <s>Bābhravya</s>, <s>Maṇḍu</s>, <s>Māṇḍavya</s>; <s>Gārgī Vācaknavī</s>, <s>Vaḍavā Prātitheyī</s>, <s>Sulabhā</s>, <s>Maitreyī</s>; <s>Kahola</s>, <s>Kauṣītaki</s>, <s>Mahā-Kauṣītaki</s>, <s>Suyajña</s>, <s>Śāṅkhāyana</s>, <s>Āśvalāyana</s>, <s>Aitareya</s>, <s>Mahā-Aitareya</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Jātūkarṇya</s>, <s>Paiṅgya</s>, <s>Mahā-Paiṅgya</s>, <s>Bāṣkala</s>, <s>Gārgya</s>, <s>Śākalya</s>, <s>Māṇḍūkeya</s>, <s>Mahā-Damatra</s>, <s>Audavāhi</s>, <s>Mahā-Audavāhi</s>, <s>Sauyāmi</s>, <s>Śaunaki</s>, <s>Śāpapūṇi</s>, <s>Gatami</s> — and whatever other teachers there are — may they all be satisfied." 4.10.4: For each male ancestor, [he names] the fathers. 4.10.5: "May the paternal lineage be satisfied." 4.10.6: "May the maternal lineage be satisfied."

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.11.0: Now, the rules for a <s>snātaka</s> (one who has completed Vedic studentship). 4.11.1: He should not look at a naked woman, except during sexual union. 4.11.2: Nor [should he look at] the sun at the two junctures [sunrise and sunset]. 4.11.3: [He should not look at] one who is untrustworthy. 4.11.4: [Nor at] one who does forbidden acts. 4.11.5: [Nor at] one who has touched a corpse. 4.11.6: He should not converse with a woman who has recently given birth or one who is menstruating. 4.11.7: And with these [aforementioned persons]. 4.11.8: He should not eat food from which the essence has been extracted. 4.11.9: He should not perform any duty with stale [materials]. 4.11.10: He should not eat together [with unworthy persons]. 4.11.11: Nor [should he eat] leftovers. 4.11.12: [But] he should eat the remainder [of food offered] to the ancestors, deities, guests, and dependents. 4.11.13: His livelihood should be gleaning (<s>uñchaśila</s>), accepting what is given unsolicited, or [accepting] when asked by virtuous people, or performing sacrifices [for others]. 4.11.14: The earlier [mentioned means of livelihood] is more meritorious than the later. 4.11.15: If that fails, [he may resort to] the livelihood of a <s>Vaiśya</s> (agriculture and trade). 4.11.16: He should be attentive in duties to ancestors and deities. 4.11.17: He should approach his own wife during her fertile season. 4.11.18: He should not sleep during the day. 4.11.19: Nor during the first and last watches of the night. 4.11.20: He should not sit on the bare ground without a covering. 4.11.21: He should always carry water. 4.11.22: He should wear the sacred thread over the left shoulder (<s>yajñopavītī</s>). 4.11.23: He should not displease his teacher. 4.11.24: Except when commanded [otherwise]. 4.11.25: Or when permitted [by the teacher].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.12.1: Day after day, one should salute the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher). 4.12.2: And the elders (<s>guru</s>s). 4.12.3: Upon meeting, [one salutes] a learned <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (<s>śrotriya</s>). 4.12.4: After returning from a journey, [one salutes] even a non-learned one. 4.12.5: "I am so-and-so, sir," having announced one's own name, crossing the hands. 4.12.6: [The elder], having clasped his hands [and addressed him as] "So-and-so," bestows a blessing. 4.12.7: One should not go to a sacrifice uninvited. 4.12.8: One should abhor unrighteousness (<s>adharma</s>). 4.12.9: One should not go to a public assembly. 4.12.10: One should not point upward upon meeting [someone]. 4.12.11: One should not be an abuser, not a slanderer; from family to family, one should not be aggressive. 4.12.12: One should not walk alone. 4.12.13: Not naked. 4.12.14: Not with covered hands. 4.12.15: [One should go] clockwise around temples (<s>devāyatana</s>). 4.12.16: One should not run. 4.12.17: One should not spit. 4.12.18: One should not scratch [oneself]. 4.12.19: One should not look at urine or excrement. 4.12.20: One should sit with covering [of the body]. 4.12.21: Not [sit] in an unscreened [place]. 4.12.22: If wearing only one garment, [one should perform] by placing the sacred thread (<s>yajñopavīta</s>) over the ear. 4.12.23: One should not [urinate] facing the sun. 4.12.24: Nor with the back [toward it]. 4.12.25: During the day, facing north; at night, facing south. 4.12.26: One should not [expectorate] phlegm into water, nor near [water]. 4.12.27: One should not climb a tree. 4.12.28: One should not look into a well. 4.12.29: One should not go to a threshing-floor. 4.12.30: And especially not to a cremation ground. 4.12.31: Day after day, one should bathe with one's garment on. 4.12.32: Having bathed, without wringing [the garment], one should put on another garment.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.13.0: Now, the agricultural rite (<s>kṛṣikarman</s>). 4.13.1: Under the <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion) of <s>Rohiṇī</s>, one should have the agricultural works performed. 4.13.2: Before the works, at the eastern boundary of the field, one should carry a <s>bali</s> offering to <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth). 4.13.3: With the <s>ṛc</s> addressed to <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, [reciting] "Homage to <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>," [he performs] the invocation (<s>upasthāna</s>). 4.13.4: At the first employment of the plough (<s>sīra</s>), a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should touch the plough, reciting "<s>Śunaṃ naḥ phālā</s>" ("May our ploughshares be auspicious"). 4.13.5: [Reciting] "With the lord of the field (<s>Kṣetrasya pati</s>)," going clockwise, he performs the invocation in each direction with the <s>ṛc</s> to the lord [of the field].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.14.0: Now, the rite of crossing water (<s>plavakarman</s>). 4.14.1: When about to cross water, one performs a rite for safe passage (<s>svastyayana</s>). 4.14.2: He offers three handfuls of water into the water [reciting]: "Homage to the ocean, to the reed-born one (<s>Vaiṇava</s>); homage to <s>Varuṇa</s>, lord of law (<s>Dharmapati</s>); homage to all the rivers." 4.14.3: Having muttered: "May the offering given to <s>Viśvakarman</s>, the father of all [rivers], be accepted." 4.14.4: [He offers] against the current for flowing [rivers]; drawing up [water] for still ones. 4.14.5: If while crossing he should apprehend danger, he should mutter the <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s> hymn "<s>Samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ</s>" ("Those whose eldest is the ocean")—this is the water-crossing [rite].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.15.0: Now, the rite for [the asterism] <s>Śravaṇā</s> (<s>śravaṇākarma</s>). 4.15.1: On the full-moon day that falls on <s>Śraviṣṭhī</s>, he offers [an oblation] of unbroken rice-grains, parched flour, or a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering). 4.15.2: 'To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>. To <s>Śravaṇā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>. To the <s>Śrāvaṇī</s> full moon, <s>svāhā</s>. To the rains, <s>svāhā</s>.' 4.15.3: Having set up the domestic fire (<s>gṛhya agni</s>) outside, having mixed parched grains and unbroken rice flour with ghee, he offers. 4.15.4: 'To the lord of the celestial serpents (<s>divya sarpas</s>), <s>svāhā</s>. To the celestial serpents, <s>svāhā</s>.' 4.15.5: To the north of the fire, on fresh <s>kuśa</s> grass with tips pointing east, he places a new water-pot. 4.15.6: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents wash [the image]. May the celestial serpents wash [it]'—thus he pours water. 4.15.7: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents draw [the lines]. May the celestial serpents draw [them]'—thus he makes markings with a serpent-hood [shaped instrument]. 4.15.8: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents anoint [it]. May the celestial serpents anoint [it]'—thus he applies a measure of pigment. 4.15.9: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents bind [it]. May the celestial serpents bind [it]'—thus he offers flowers (<s>sumanas</s>). 4.15.10: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents cover [it]. May the celestial serpents cover [it]'—thus he offers a thread. 4.15.11: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents apply collyrium. May the celestial serpents apply collyrium'—thus with a young <s>kuśa</s> blade he applies a stroke of <s>āñjana</s> (collyrium). 4.15.12: 'May the lord of the celestial serpents behold [it]. May the celestial serpents behold [it]'—thus he shows [the image] in a mirror. 4.15.13: 'O lord of the celestial serpents, this is your offering. O celestial serpents, this is your offering'—thus he presents the <s>bali</s> (offering). 4.15.14: In the same manner for the [serpents] of the atmosphere. 4.15.15: For those of the directions. 4.15.16: And for those of the earth. 4.15.17: Three times each, progressively louder, the first [set]. 4.15.18: Progressively softer, the latter [set]. 4.15.19: Thus, day after day, he should offer the <s>bali</s> of unbroken rice flour with a ladle, accompanied by water, at night, observing silence, until the <s>pratyavarohaṇa</s> (re-entry ceremony). 4.15.20: And observing silence, he should approach [the serpent image]. 4.15.21: The commencement [procedure] is the same as the concluding [procedure]. 4.15.22: [Reciting] '<s>sutrāmāṇam</s>' (the protector), he ascends his bed.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.16.0: Now, the rite for the <s>Āśvayujī</s> [full moon]. 4.16.1: On the <s>Āśvayujī</s> full moon, [he prepares] a milk-rice offering (<s>pāyasa</s>) for <s>Indra</s>. 4.16.2: 'To the two <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>svāhā</s>. To the two yoked [horses] (<s>aśvayuj</s>), <s>svāhā</s>. To the <s>Āśvayujī</s> full moon, <s>svāhā</s>. To autumn (<s>śarad</s>), <s>svāhā</s>. To <s>Paśupati</s> (lord of beasts), <s>svāhā</s>. To the tawny one (<s>Piṅgala</s>), <s>svāhā</s>'—having offered ghee [with these mantras]. 4.16.3: Then, with the speckled [cow's milk] (<s>pṛṣātaka</s>), he should offer verse by verse with the hymn 'The cows have come (<s>ā gāvo agman</s>).' 4.16.4: The calves are united with their mothers for that one dark night. 4.16.5: Then, the feeding of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.17.0: Now, the rite for the <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s> [full moon]. 4.17.1: On the <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s> [full moon], one should perform the <s>pratyavarohaṇa</s> (descent / re-entry [to sleeping on beds]). 4.17.2: On the <s>Rohiṇī</s> [asterism], or on the <s>Proṣṭhapadās</s>. 4.17.3: In the morning, taking a full handful of [twigs of] <s>śamī</s>, <s>palāśa</s>, <s>madhūka</s>, <s>iṣīkā</s>, <s>apāmārga</s>, <s>śirīṣa</s>, <s>udumbara</s>, <s>kuśa</s>, young [shoots] (<s>taruṇa</s>), and <s>badarī</s>, together with a cold clod of earth. 4.17.4: Having placed [them] in a water vessel. 4.17.5: Having pronounced the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s> and the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, [reciting] the hymn 'O <s>Agni</s>, may the impurity near us be burned away (<s>upa naḥ śośucad agham</s>),' immersing [himself] again and again in that [water], having warded off evil from those seeking shelter by circumambulating, he should lead [the water] to the north. 4.17.6: A <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee).

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.18.0: Now, the serpent offering rite (<s>sarpa-bali-karma</s>). ŚGS 4.18.1: 'Summer, winter, or spring, autumn, the rains—may it be well done for us. Of those seasons, of a hundred autumns, sheltered among them, may we be free from fear. <s>Svāhā</s>. Strike away, O white one, with your feet, from before and behind. And these seven [serpents] belonging to <s>Varuṇa</s>, and all with their royal kinsmen. <s>Svāhā</s>. To the white one (<s>Śveta</s>), the son of <s>Vidārva</s>. <s>Svāhā</s>. To <s>Vidārva</s>. <s>Svāhā</s>. To <s>Takṣaka</s>, the son of <s>Viśāla</s>. <s>Svāhā</s>. To <s>Viśāla</s>. <s>Svāhā</s>' — having offered ghee [with these <s>mantras</s>]. ŚGS 4.18.2: 'May a good winter, a good spring, a good summer be established. May the rains be good rains for us; may the autumns bring us welfare.' Thus. ŚGS 4.18.3: [Reciting] '<s>śaṃ no Mitraḥ</s>' ('May <s>Mitra</s> be auspicious to us'), having wiped [the ground] with a <s>palāśa</s> branch. ŚGS 4.18.4: [Reciting] '<s>samudrād ūrmiḥ</s>' ('A wave from the ocean'), having sprinkled. ŚGS 4.18.5: [Reciting] '<s>syonā pṛthivi bhava</s>' ('Be gentle, O Earth'), having spread a soft bed. ŚGS 4.18.6: The eldest [lies down] on the right side; they lie down on their sides. ŚGS 4.18.7: 'I establish myself in sacred knowledge (<s>Brahman</s>), I establish myself in ruling power (<s>Kṣatra</s>)' — with the right [limbs]. ŚGS 4.18.8: 'I establish myself in horses, I establish myself in cattle' — with the left [limbs]. ŚGS 4.18.9: 'I establish myself in livestock, I establish myself in nourishment' — with the right [limbs]. ŚGS 4.18.10: 'I establish myself in offspring, I establish myself in food' — with the left [limbs]. ŚGS 4.18.11: [Reciting] '<s>ud īrdhvam jīva</s>' ('Rise up, live!') — the rising. ŚGS 4.18.12: On the soft bed they sleep that night. ŚGS 4.18.13: After that, as is comfortable.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 4.19.0: Now, the <s>Caitrī</s> rite (<s>caitrī-karma</s>). ŚGS 4.19.1: On the full-moon day of <s>Caitra</s>. ŚGS 4.19.2: Having made from flour, <s>karkandhu</s> (jujube) leaves and [figures of] pairs [of animals], as available. ŚGS 4.19.3: The pot-bellied [figure] (<s>tuṇḍila</s>) belongs to <s>Indra</s>-and-<s>Agni</s>. ŚGS 4.19.4: The round balls (<s>golaka</s>) [belong] to <s>Rudra</s>. ŚGS 4.19.5: From common knowledge, the <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions) and the copies; from common knowledge, the <s>nakṣatras</s> and the copies.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.1.0: Now, the mounting [of the fire] (<s>samārohaṇa</s>). ŚGS 5.1.1: Now, one who is about to depart mounts the fire into himself, or into the fire-sticks (<s>araṇī</s>), or into a fuel-stick (<s>samidh</s>). ŚGS 5.1.2: 'Come, mount into my breath (<s>prāṇa</s>)' — once with the <s>mantra</s> each time, twice silently each time. ŚGS 5.1.3: Or [reciting] '<s>ayam te yoniḥ</s>' ('This is your womb'), he warms the fire-sticks. ŚGS 5.1.4: Or a fuel-stick. ŚGS 5.1.5: And the churning [of fire] before sunset. ŚGS 5.1.6: And at the time of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [offering]. ŚGS 5.1.7: Having smeared, raised, and sprinkled [the altar ground], having brought ordinary fire, [reciting] 'Descend (<s>upāvaroha</s>)!' — this is the descending (<s>upāvarohaṇa</s>), the re-establishment of the fire. ŚGS 5.1.8: When the fire has been re-established, having offered all the expiatory oblations (<s>prāyaścitta-āhuti</s>): 'Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, for our prosperity. <s>Svāhā</s>. Protect us, O all-knowing one. <s>Svāhā</s>. Protect the sacrifice, O radiant one (<s>Vibhāvasu</s>). <s>Svāhā</s>. Protect all, O hundred-powered one (<s>Śatakratu</s>). <s>Svāhā</s>.' ŚGS 5.1.9: For a breach of a vow (<s>vrata-hāna</s>), having fasted and having offered ghee, [reciting] '<s>tvam agne vratapā</s>' ('You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the protector of vows').

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.2.0: Now, the consecration (<s>utsarga</s>). ŚGS 5.2.1: Now, of lotus ponds (<s>puṣkariṇī</s>), wells (<s>kūpa</s>), and tanks (<s>taḍāga</s>). ŚGS 5.2.2: In the bright fortnight (<s>śuddha-pakṣa</s>), or on an auspicious <s>tithi</s> (lunar day). ŚGS 5.2.3: Having cooked a barley porridge (<s>caru</s>) with milk. ŚGS 5.2.4: [With the <s>mantras</s>:] '<s>tvam no agna</s>' ('You, O <s>Agni</s>') — with two [verses]; '<s>ava te heḷa</s>' ('Away with your anger'); '<s>imam me Varuṇa</s>' ('This [prayer] of mine, O <s>Varuṇa</s>'); '<s>ud uttamam Varuṇa</s>' ('Up, the highest, O <s>Varuṇa</s>'); '<s>imāṃ dhiyam śikṣamāṇasya</s>' ('This prayer of one who is learning'). ŚGS 5.2.5: '<s>Gṛhya</s>, <s>Apagṛhya</s>, <s>Mayobhū</s>, <s>Ākhara</s>, <s>Nikhara</s>, <s>Nihsara</s>, <s>Nikāma</s>, Destroyer of Rivals (<s>Sapatna-dūṣaṇa</s>)' — starting from the western direction, he should offer clockwise. ŚGS 5.2.6: In the middle, he offers with milk, [reciting] '<s>viśvataś cakṣuḥ</s>' ('Having eyes everywhere') [and] '<s>idam Viṣṇuḥ</s>' ('This [step] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'). ŚGS 5.2.7: [Reciting] '<s>yat kiṃ ca idam</s>' ('Whatever this [may be]'), having immersed [the offering]. ŚGS 5.2.8: A cow is the priestly fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>), and a pair of garments. ŚGS 5.2.9: After that, the feeding of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.3.0: Now, the rite for consecrating a garden (<s>ārāma-pratiṣṭhā-karma</s>). ŚGS 5.3.1: Now, having set up the fire in the garden (<s>ārāma</s>). ŚGS 5.3.2: Having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering). ŚGS 5.3.3: 'To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>. To <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>. To <s>Viśvakarman</s>, <s>svāhā</s>' — [reciting] '<s>yān vo nara</s>' ('Whatever, O men'), verse by verse he should offer. ŚGS 5.3.4: [Reciting] '<s>vanaspate śata-valśa</s>' ('O lord of the forest, of a hundred branches'), having consecrated [the trees]. ŚGS 5.3.5: Gold is the priestly fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>).

ŚGS_5.4.5: prātaḥ.prātar.vastar.namaḥ.svāhā.iti /
ŚGS_5.4.6: yāvanto.homās.tāvatīr.hutvā.pūrvavadd.homaḥ /
body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.4.0: Now, the expiations (<s>prāyaścittas</s>). 5.4.1: If one of the two [new- and full-moon offerings] of the <s>pārvaṇa</s> [rite] has not been performed, then a <s>caru</s> (boiled grain offering) [is required]. 5.4.2: [With the formulas:] 'To <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'To <s>Agni Tantumat</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 5.4.3: When there has been an omission of the <s>homa</s>. 5.4.4: In the evening: '<s>dośā vastar namaḥ svāhā</s>' ('Homage to the cloth-wearer of the evening, <s>svāhā</s>!'). 5.4.5: In the morning: '<s>prātar vastar namaḥ svāhā</s>' ('Homage to the cloth-wearer of the morning, <s>svāhā</s>!'). 5.4.6: Having offered as many [expiation oblations] as there were [missed] <s>homas</s>, the [regular] <s>homa</s> [is performed] as before.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.5.1: When a pigeon or an owl alights [on the house]. 5.5.2: One should offer with each verse [of the hymn] '<s>devāḥ kapota</s>' (RV 10.165). 5.5.3: And upon seeing a bad dream, and upon seeing an ill omen. 5.5.4: And when the sound of a crow is heard at night. 5.5.5: And at other portents. 5.5.6: Having cooked a <s>caru</s> with milk. 5.5.7: In the milk of a cow whose calf is of the same color. 5.5.8: But not of a black [cow]. 5.5.9: One should offer with each verse of the <s>Rātrī-sūkta</s> (RV 10.127). 5.5.10: Having eaten the remainder of the oblation with the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s> (great utterances). 5.5.11: [Touching] the ears with '<s>bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ</s>' (RV 1.89.8). 5.5.12: Having consecrated oneself with '<s>śatam in nu śarado anti devāḥ</s>' (RV 1.89.9). 5.5.13: One should give something to <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.6.1: When illness has arisen. 5.6.2: One should offer a <s>caru</s> of <s>gāvedhuka</s> (coix grain) with each verse of '<s>imā rudrāya tavase kapardine</s>' (RV 1.114).

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.7.1: If [the child] is born when the <s>sīmanta-unnayana</s> (hair-parting ceremony) has not been performed. 5.7.2: [Or when] the <s>jāta-karma</s> (birth rite) has not been performed. 5.7.3: Then, after ten days have passed, placing the child in the mother's lap. 5.7.4: Having offered with the <s>Mahāvyāhṛtis</s>, the <s>homa</s> [is performed] as before.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.8.1: When a [wooden] pillar [of the house] sprouts. 5.8.2: Having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering), one should offer a <s>caru</s> with the two [verses]: '<s>ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi</s>' and '<s>piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ</s>' (RV 2.3.9). 5.8.3: If the <s>praṇītā</s> (consecrated water vessel), the <s>caru</s> [pot], the ghee pot, or any other earthen vessel breaks or leaks. 5.8.4: Having offered all the expiation oblations, one consecrates the broken [vessel] with the <s>tṛca</s> (three-verse group) '<s>ya ṛte cid</s>.' 5.8.5: If, when the <s>homa</s> is not completed, the purifying strainers (<s>pavitras</s>) are lost. 5.8.6: Having offered the complete expiation, one should produce [fire] again with '<s>apsv agna</s>' ('O <s>Agni</s>, in the waters').

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.9.0: Now, the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s> (incorporation into the ancestral group). 5.9.1: Now, the <s>sapiṇḍīkaraṇa</s>. 5.9.2: Having filled four water vessels: 'The harmonious ancestors in <s>Yama</s>'s kingdom.' 5.9.3: 'Their world, <s>svadhā</s>, homage — may the sacrifice be established among the gods. Those who are the same, harmonious, the living among the living, my own.' 5.9.4: 'May their prosperity be established in me, in this world, for a hundred years.' With the two [verses beginning] '<s>samāno mantra</s>,' one should divide the first <s>piṇḍa</s> into the three [vessels]. 5.9.5: Likewise with the <s>arghya</s> (guest-offering) vessels. 5.9.6: In the same way for the mother, brother, wife, [or] one who has died before — casting [offerings] with these <s>piṇḍas</s>.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.10.0: Now, the expiations (<s>prāyaścittas</s>). 5.10.1: If bees make honey in the house. 5.10.2: After fasting, one should offer eight hundred fig-wood (<s>audumbarī</s>) fuel-sticks smeared with yogurt, honey, and ghee, with the two [verses] '<s>mā nas toke</s>.' 5.10.3: And one should recite the hymn '<s>śam no indrāgnī</s>' at all rites beginning with the <s>pratiśruta</s> (responding call). 5.10.4: Having offered seventeen <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) fuel-sticks of a span's length, afterwards [he takes up] the <s>sruva</s> (ladle). 5.10.5: At the new- and full-moon [rites], fifteen [fuel-sticks]. 5.10.6: During the middle of the rainy season, at the <s>aṣṭakā</s> rite, there are three [fuel-sticks]; the <s>homa</s> is like the <s>pitṛ-yajña</s> (ancestor sacrifice).

ŚGS_5.11.2: atha.trirātram.upoṣya.mahā.śāntim.kuryāt.mahā.śāntim.kuryāt /
body.translated_text: ŚGS 5.11.1: If an anthill (<s>valmīka</s>) arises in the house, [there should be] abandonment of the house. 5.11.2: Then, after fasting for three nights, one should perform the great pacification (<s>mahā-śānti</s>). One should perform the great pacification.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.1.0: Rules for the <s>svādhyāya</s> (self-study) of the <s>Āraṇyaka</s>. 6.1.1: Now, having paid homage to <s>Brahman</s>, the <s>Brahmarṣi</s> (Brahman-seer), <s>Brahmayoni</s> (source of Brahman), <s>Indra</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Vāmadeva</s>, <s>Kahola</s>, <s>Kauṣītaki</s>, <s>Mahā-Kauṣītaki</s>, <s>Suyajña</s>, <s>Śāṅkhāyana</s>, <s>Āśvalāyana</s>, <s>Aitareya</s>, <s>Mahā-Aitareya</s>, <s>Kātyāyana</s>, <s>Śāṭyāyana</s>, <s>Śākalya</s>, <s>Babhru</s>, <s>Bābhravya</s>, <s>Maṇḍu</s>, <s>Māṇḍavya</s>, and all the former teachers, we shall set forth the rules for the self-study of the <s>Āraṇyaka</s>. 6.1.2: Having observed <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy) for a day and night, the teacher should abstain from eating meat. 6.1.3: [Seeing] raw flesh, a <s>Caṇḍāla</s>, a woman who has recently given birth, a menstruating woman, or a person making gestures of dismissal — these are occasions for suspension of study (<s>anadhyāya</s>). 6.1.4: And [upon seeing] things resembling a corpse. 6.1.5: [Also things] that should not enter the mouth. 6.1.6: [Suspension of study applies] after vomiting and after shaving. 6.1.7: [And] on occasions of eating meat, <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites), and meals during impurity (<s>sūtaka</s>). 6.1.8: On days not separated from village study. 6.1.9: For three nights [suspension applies] when one is unprepared. 6.1.10: [And when] touched by another [impure person]. 6.1.11: And during the latter halves of the days of the <s>upaparvan</s> (minor lunar days). 6.1.12: And upon the appearance of fire, lightning, thunder, rain, or great clouds. 6.1.13: And when there is a wind carrying gravel, for as long as it lasts.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.2.1: After <s>Āṣāḍhī</s> (full moon of Āṣāḍha), one should not study for four months. 6.2.2: Up to the <s>Śakvarī</s> [verses] — these are the rules. 6.2.3: Before daybreak, in the unconquered (<s>aparājitā</s>) direction [northeast], having approached a sacred place, 6.2.4: water should be taken before sunrise. 6.2.5: And entry into the <s>maṇḍala</s> (sacred circle) [is done] with the verse beginning "<s>añjana-gandhim</s>" ("fragrant with collyrium"). 6.2.6: The <s>maṇḍala</s> should have its entrance facing east or north, should not be [covered with] goat-skin at the front, should be of proper measure and not crowded. 6.2.7: Up to the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, the concluding <s>śānti</s> (peace invocation) [is recited]. 6.2.8: And then the invitation to study again. 6.2.9: Having sipped water with those standing outside the <s>maṇḍala</s>, 6.2.10: they should study, having performed the <s>śānti</s> rites. 6.2.11: If the <s>śānti</s> vessel is damaged, sprinkling is the expiation. 6.2.12: The sprinkling [is done] with a hand holding gold or with one holding a tuft of <s>darbha</s> grass. 6.2.13: Thus [ends] the explanatory [section].

body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.3.1: Now, having entered the <s>maṇḍala</s> (sacred circle), 6.3.2: the teacher sits facing east; the others [sit] to the south, facing north, according to precedence. 6.3.3: When that is not possible, [they sit] facing all directions. 6.3.4: They should wait for the rising of the sun. 6.3.5: And having perceived it possessing rays, 6.3.6: [The students say] "Teach, O venerable one" — grasping the teacher's washed feet with the right [hands on the] right [foot] and the left [hands on the] left [foot], [or] with right and left hands [together]. 6.3.7: Then, having placed <s>dūrvā</s> grass with stalks in the <s>śānti</s> vessel in water, with hands not dripping, they should study. 6.3.8: This is the rule; but if they become tired, one of them should keep the <s>śānti</s> vessel from being empty. 6.3.9: And at the beginning and end of a lesson, all [should participate]. 6.3.10: That [study] is continuous and uninterrupted. 6.3.11: Now, the <s>śānti</s> (peace invocation): 6.3.12: The <s>Oṃkāra</s>, the great <s>Vyāhṛtis</s>, the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the <s>Rathantara</s>, the <s>Bṛhat</s>, the <s>Vāmadevya</s>, [the hymn called] <s>Punarādāya</s> in <s>kakubh</s> form — thus [are recited] the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s>. 6.3.13: These ten are thus accomplished. 6.3.14: "Ten, tenfold, <s>Virāj</s>" — this is the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [explanation].

ŚGS_6.4.10: ity.āhnikam /
body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.4.1: [Reciting] "Uninjured mind, vigorous eye, the sun, best of lights—O consecration (<s>dīkṣā</s>), do not harm me," they look at <s>Savitṛ</s> (the Sun). 6.4.2: "<s>Yuvam surāmam</s>"—one [<s>ṛc</s>]; and "<s>Svasti naḥ pathyāsu</s>"—three [<s>ṛc</s>s]: this is for the <s>Mahāvrata</s> [ceremony]. 6.4.3: But for the <s>Śakvarī</s> [verses], [these come] before. 6.4.4: "<s>Praty asmai pipīṣate</s>," "<s>Yo rayivo rayitamaḥ</s>," "<s>Tyam u vo aprahaṇam</s>"—three sets of three <s>ṛc</s>s; "<s>Asmā asmā id andhasaḥ</s>" and "<s>Evā hy asi vīrayuḥ</s>"—[these go] on both sides of the <s>Śakvarī</s> [verses]. 6.4.5: Now, [the procedure] for the <s>Upaniṣads</s>. 6.4.6: It is the same as for the <s>Mahāvrata</s>. 6.4.7: But for the <s>Saṃhitās</s>, [these come] before; the distinction is [the addition of] "I shall speak <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), I shall speak <s>satya</s> (truth)." 6.4.8: Now, for the <s>mantha</s> (churned offering): "<s>Tat Savituḥ vṛṇīmahe</s>" [and] "<s>Tat Savitur vareṇyam</s>"—and the preceding [mantras]. 6.4.9: "<s>Adabdham manaḥ</s>"—these are the governing pacification [mantras]; thereafter [the rite proceeds]. 6.4.10: Thus [ends] the daily observance (<s>āhnika</s>).

body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.4.11: Now, at the time of rising, having removed sin: 6.4.12: having performed the regular pacification (<s>śānti</s>), 6.4.13: [reciting] "Having risen, I place the bright one," they look at <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun). 6.5.1: "Him I [place] in myself"—[reciting this], one places [the sun] within oneself, deposited three times. 6.5.2: "May <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity) attend me, may <s>yaśas</s> (glory) [attend me]; may <s>Śrī</s> follow me, may <s>yaśas</s> follow me." 6.5.3: "Like <s>Indra</s>—with his host, with his strength, with his glory, with his power—may I rise!" Thus he rises. 6.5.4: "May <s>Śrī</s> rise up for me, may <s>yaśas</s> rise up for me"—[he recites] upon rising. 6.5.5: "This—the hostile rival, sin, and <s>Alakṣmī</s> (misfortune)—I shake off!" Thus he shakes the edge of his garment. 6.5.6: "<s>Apa prācaḥ</s>"—the [entire] <s>sūkta</s>; "<s>Indraś ca mṛlayāti naḥ</s>"—two [<s>ṛc</s>s]; "<s>Yata Indra bhayāmahe</s>"—one [<s>ṛc</s>]; "<s>Śāsa itthā mahān asi</s>"—[facing] east; "<s>Svastidā</s>"—[facing] south, turning rightward; "<s>Virakṣa</s>"—[facing] west; "<s>Vi na Indra</s>"—[facing] north, turning leftward; "<s>Apa Indra</s>"—turning rightward, they look up at the sky.

body.translated_text: ŚGS 6.6.1: <s>Savitṛ</s> [presides over the rite] from behind. [Reciting] "<s>Tac cakṣuḥ</s>" ("That eye [of the gods]"), one approaches (<s>upasthāna</s>) <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun). 6.6.2: And turning around, they return and sit down. 6.6.3: As [prescribed by] "<s>Apaḥ śāntāḥ</s>" ("Waters, be pacified"), having taken water from the pacification vessel (<s>śāntipātra</s>), 6.6.4: and having poured it on the ground, 6.6.5: with "<s>Yathā pṛthivī</s>" ("As the earth"), they draw it [toward themselves]. 6.6.6: With "<s>Evam mayi śāmyatu</s>" ("Thus may it be pacified in me"), one anoints the right shoulder. 6.6.7: Thus a second time. 6.6.8: Thus a third time. 6.6.9: "From joint to joint you are born, from joint to joint you sprout forth; '<s>Śivā naḥ śāle bhava</s>' ('O dwelling, be auspicious to us')"—having taken a stalk of <s>dūrvā</s> grass and placed it on the head. 6.6.10: "May <s>Agni</s> be satisfied, may <s>Vāyu</s> be satisfied, may <s>Sūrya</s> be satisfied, may <s>Viṣṇu</s> be satisfied, may <s>Prajāpati</s> be satisfied, may <s>Virūpākṣa</s> be satisfied, may <s>Sahasrākṣa</s> (Thousand-eyed one) be satisfied, may all beings be satisfied." 6.6.11: <s>Sumantu</s>, <s>Jaimini</s>, <s>Vaiśampāyana</s>, <s>Paila</s>, and the other <s>ācāryas</s> (teachers) [are invoked]. 6.6.12: [Then] the personal ancestors (<s>pitṛs</s>). 6.6.13: With "<s>Samudram va</s>," one pours the waters away. 6.6.14: Having recited the <s>Vāmadevya</s> [<s>sāman</s>], 6.6.15: they disperse as they wish. 6.6.16: "By the authority of tradition (<s>āgama</s>), insight (<s>prajñā</s>), revelation (<s>śruti</s>), and tradition (<s>smṛti</s>), following [the teachings] in proper succession, established without dispute—may there be for us fearlessness, well-being; homage to gods, <s>ṛṣis</s>, ancestors, and humans. May they increase for us auspicious life, beauty, health, peace, safety, imperishability, vital power, splendor, glory, strength, <s>brahma</s>-radiance, fame, longevity, progeny, and cattle. Homage, homage! From what has been poorly praised, poorly employed, deficient or excessive—from all that, <s>svasti</s>! May the gods and <s>ṛṣis</s> [protect us], and may <s>Brahman</s> and <s>Satya</s> (Truth) protect me"—"May <s>Brahman</s> and <s>Satya</s> protect me."
